text:
jess (prod): ok team — need a quick decision on sliced launch scope for the "Sliced Launch" routing change. Acme asked for per-tenant opt-in + priority routing. Proposal below, want callouts on canary size, flags, telemetry gates, and fallback.

mike (pm): Acme is pushing to opt-in their org early. My read: ship a conservative GA (no forced opt-in), offer per-tenant opt-in for enterprise customers. Defer global A/B until after we validate stability.

aline (sre): SRE note: added routing hops could increase tail latency. Recommend internal-only smoke (synthetic + dogfooding) -> 1% targeted canary (internal + pilot tenants) before any public ramp. Add circuit-breaker: if latency P95 > 300ms or error rate > 0.5% for 5m, auto-fallback.

sam (eng): Implementation plan: add two feature flags: `sliced_launch/tenant_opt_in` and `sliced_launch/region_rollout`. Estimate 3 dev days + 1 telemetry day. Default behavior: requests use new routing when flag enabled; on fallback we route to `model-v1` (baseline). We can add per-tenant KV cache warmup to avoid cold-start thrash.

rachel (cs): Customer ask: they want opt-in + an opt-out path, plus a short pre-roll notice. Also wants SLA language around response latency during pilot. We should prepare a short onboarding checklist for pilot customers.

jess (prod): Proposed rollout schedule: week0 internal smoke; week1 NA pilot (5% traffic from pilot tenants + internal); week2 NA ramp to 25% if signals good; week3 add EU internal tests + EU pilot (5%); week4 evaluate for GA. Gate signals: error rate <= 0.5% (per-model & per-tenant), latency P95 < 250ms, no regressions on our red-team prompt set.

mike (pm): also want a small A/B on quality/cost for premium vs default routing: 10% traffic experiment after NA pilot. Keep experiment isolated by tenant tag.

aline (sre): Fallback automation (suggestion): when any of these are tripped -> flip feature flag `sliced_launch/fallback=true` for affected region/tenant and trigger alert to ops. Sample toggle command for on-call:

```
# toggle flag for tenant
curl -X POST https://flags.redwood.local/api/v1/flags/sliced_launch/tenant_opt_in -d '{"tenant":"acme","enabled":true}'

# emergency fallback
curl -X POST https://flags.redwood.local/api/v1/flags/sliced_launch/fallback -d '{"region":"na","enabled":true}'
```

sam (eng): we'll emit rollout metadata into traces and metrics: `rollout_id`, `tenant`, `region`, `canary_bucket`. That'll let us slice quality and cost metrics. We'll also add a KV cache pre-warm hook during rollout to avoid cascades.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary/routing-change job queued for 1711112800 — notify #eng-oncall when started.

jess (prod): quick final tradeoff notes: keep the core GA minimal (routing + flag + telemetry). Defer per-tenant A/B experiments and premium routing logic to post-GA unless Acme pays for accelerated pilot.

ACTIONS:
- sam: PR for flags + trace tags (ETA 3d)
- aline: add circuit-breaker playbook + automation runbook (ETA 2d)
- rachel: pilot onboarding checklist + customer notice copy (ETA 1d)
- mike: confirm SLA language with legal and Acme (ETA 2d)
- jess: finalize rollout dates after PRs land

jess (prod): anything blocking? :eyes:

mike (pm): nothing blocking from PM side. :thumbsup:

aline (sre): will schedule a quick runthrough with oncall before canary.

sam (eng): will open the PR today and tag everyone.

rachel (cs): I'll queue Acme for opt-in once we have the internal smoke results.

end of thread.
